shelter

Mara

CANDIDATE BEAT

Classify only whether CANDIDATE BEAT establishes that NAMED SUBJECT is physically at/inside DESTINATION at any point during the beat. Allowed values: AT_DESTINATION, NOT_AT_DESTINATION, UNSPECIFIED. Reaching through an opening while the subject's body remains outside is NOT_AT_DESTINATION. UNSPECIFIED means the subject's relation to DESTINATION is not established clearly enough. Do not decide whether the placement is allowed. Return JSON: {"relation":"..."}
